title: spec: the authoring hint for the mistyped field key `tracked` still says per-field history is `trackHistory: true`, which no longer changes anything for most fields
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by the seat from the #36290 card thread, on a nit the contract review of PR #36399 left (record 7080007398: "the authoring hint for the mistyped key `tracked` ... still says per-field timeline tracking is `trackHistory: true`. After this head that advice changes nothing for most fields"). Not claimed. Related: #36290, #36482.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:spec`

## Where

`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, the field schema's unknown-key guidance table, row `tracked`:
`'`tracked` is not a field key — per-field timeline tracking is `trackHistory: true` (ADR-0052 §5b).'`

## Why it is wrong now

Field change history is now resolved by default per field type, with an object-level switch and a per-field Default / On / Off setting (#36399, #36482; #36290 segment ① rewrites the producer side). An author who mistypes `tracked` is told to write a key that, for most field types, changes nothing.

## Ask

Rewrite the row so it names what an author writes today to turn one field's history on or off, matching the final shape of #36290 segment ①. Wording only, no key change. Land after #36290 segment ① merges, so the hint names the shape that shipped.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "tracked:" packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` shows the old sentence until fixed.
